final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: 10uA reference sink and mirrors
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=2
M5  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=8
M8  vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=30
* first stage: NMOS diff pair + PMOS mirror load (smaller load -> higher mirror pole)
M1  n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=40 L=2
M2  n2 vinp tail vss nfet W=40 L=2
M3  n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=1
M4  n2 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=1
* second stage: PMOS CS, current density matched to M3/M4 (W/L ratio 7.5 = I7/I4)
M7  vout n2 vdd vdd pfet W=75 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor (LHP zero near output pole)
Rz  n2 nc 2k
Cc  nc vout 1.5p
.ends
